title: Ray Nance, Duke Ellington and loving the old man
summary: Willard and Jones discuss Ray Nance's devotion to Duke Ellington and their sense that Duke was unlike anyone else.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Yeah, he loved Duke. He called him his musical father and --
The guys really down deep in their hearts, they loved the old man.
Well, some more than others. I think Ray for instance more than some of the others.
I mean Ray knew and had recognized and come up against the other side of Duke, but he still loved him very much.
Yeah. And I saw the other side of him, but I still loved him, you know? He had something.
I don't know what it was, but he had something.
Well, there was just no place in life you could find the Ellington experience except right there
